about: The method of record per kind of step: what a film or still is ordered with in the studio's view Beställ (model, text style, seconds, takes, turn, reference film rule, Jakob's addition) and whether that is settled. status gäller: ordered without further trial (two takes per clip); prov: still being tried, one change and one take per trial (the recipe here is the next trial, the leading candidate); saknas: no method yet. seats narrows a deal to a class of seats where the evidence differs: mitten P3-P5, ytter P1, P2, P6, P7, dealer D.C1 and D.C2. reference: ingen, or samma-plats-rakt-godkänd (a take of the bank to the same seat and step that Jakob approved straight, of any dealer; without one the step waits, or is ordered with noReferenceModel and no reference). turn: plan (what Placering says per card) or a turn of src/order-model.ts. Read by src/order-methods.ts (checked against the steps, models and styles that exist) and the production list (tools/produce.ts, Beställ). Evidence: order ids, the independent reviewer's scores (the protocol, node tools/order-ledger.ts) and Jakob's own words quoted from motions/<id>.json (review.userReview). Methods are the same for every dealer; the evidence is Paow's. Change a status only on evidence, and say who and when. No template number is written here: an order's own template name (data/orders/<id>.json prompt.template) says which text it was written with.
